features: Key Features: Extreme High Density Storage Chassis support 24x (12 front + 12 middle) 3.5" SAS/SATA 12Gb/s Hot-Swap Bays
Single Expander Backplane Boards support SAS/SATA HDDs with 12Gb/s throughput
4x Mini-SAS HD ports for Internal/External Cascading
1000W (1+1) Redundant High-efficiency Titanium Level power supplies with PMBus
JBOD Power Control Board with IPMI for remote monitor and power on-off; Internal Connection Cables Included

Qualified SAS HBA / controller:
AOC-SAS3-9500-8E - 12Gb/s 2-external ports SAS3 HBA
AOC-SAS3-9500-16E - 12Gb/s 4-external ports SAS3 HBA
AOC-SAS3-9580-8I8E - 12Gb/s 2-external ports SAS3 RAID Controller
